description: This file defines the 'Location' class in the OpenMRS project, representing a physical site such as a hospital, clinic, or other location. It includes properties for address details, hierarchical relationships (parent/child locations), tags, and associated concepts. The class implements various methods for managing location hierarchy, addressing, tags, and integration with OpenMRS APIs.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a physical location with address details, hierarchy, and tags, used within the OpenMRS system to model locations like clinics, hospitals, and districts.

methods.name: getAddress1
methods.description: Returns the first line of the address of the location.

methods.name: setAddress1
methods.description: Sets the first line of the address.

methods.name: getAddress2
methods.description: Returns the second line of the address.

methods.name: setAddress2
methods.description: Sets the second line of the address.

methods.name: getCityVillage
methods.description: Returns the city or village name.

methods.name: setCityVillage
methods.description: Sets the city or village name.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country name.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country name.

methods.name: getLatitude
methods.description: Returns the geographic latitude.

methods.name: setLatitude
methods.description: Sets the geographic latitude.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the location.

methods.name: setLocationId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the location.

methods.name: getLongitude
methods.description: Returns the geographic longitude.

methods.name: setLongitude
methods.description: Sets the geographic longitude.

methods.name: getPostalCode
methods.description: Returns the postal code.

methods.name: setPostalCode
methods.description: Sets the postal code.

methods.name: getStateProvince
methods.description: Returns the state or province.

methods.name: setStateProvince
methods.description: Sets the state or province.

methods.name: getParentLocation
methods.description: Returns the parent location in the hierarchy.

methods.name: setParentLocation
methods.description: Sets the parent location.

methods.name: getChildLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of child locations.

methods.name: getChildLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of child locations, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getDescendantLocations
methods.description: Returns all descendant locations, including or excluding retired ones.

methods.name: setChildLocations
methods.description: Sets the child locations.

methods.name: addChildLocation
methods.description: Adds a child location, maintaining hierarchy constraints.

methods.name: isInHierarchy
methods.description: Checks if a location is within the hierarchy starting at a root location.

methods.name: removeChildLocation
methods.description: Removes a specified child location.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns tags associated with the location.

methods.name: setTags
methods.description: Sets tags for the location.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Attaches a tag to the location.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a tag from the location.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Checks if the location has a specific tag.

methods.name: hydrate
methods.description: Reconstructs a Location object from an ID string.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the location to its ID string.

methods.name: getDisplayString
methods.description: Returns the display string for the location, typically its name.
